title: Simple Arithmetic Expression Evaluator

content.problemStatement:
Get three inputs in the format-integer,character,integer. The inputs are all seperated by spaces. Perform the operation with the integer values based on the
character(+,-,*,/). Display the calculated value as the output.
Ex : 23 + 45
o/p : 68

solution.approach: Evaluate simple binary arithmetic expression: A op B.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Read operand A, operator op, and operand B. Perform '+', '-', '*', or '/' (integer division).

hints: Parse the three tokens: integer, operator character, integer.
Use switch or if-else on operator (+, -, *, /).
